comment: Hand edits applied by pads.py build. remove: pad ids to drop. names: id -> display name. add: pads the scan cannot find, each {id, name, pos: [x, y, deck z], yaw, radius, note}; they get the same deck check as found pads, except own_deck ones (a deck from our own sector, not in the nav map), and replace a found pad with the same id. The spaceport (Phantom Liberty, q306) has no pad meshes in the open-world sectors, so its spots are picked from the nav map (flat, open sky, 12 m radius).
remove_comment: Visual-only decks: no cooked collision under them (tools/pads/pad_collision.py, levels 0 to 3, 2026-10-26). The spaceport's launch pad 2 has only proxies. Take one off this list once a sector of our own gives it a real deck (docs/design/landing-pads.md, step 8; the 499 m tower v2 went that way, see add).
